answer: Rotate the grading panel each epoch from a verifiable randomness beacon, and treat reputation as nectar that only accrues when a random atlas of active validators, re-drawn unpredictably every round, grades your work. Fixed juries can never form, since collusion partners learn who grades whom only after the draw. To keep a fake identity influential an attacker must sustain thousands of cheap sybil identities through every random draw across epochs, paying stake deposits and work fees each round; below the honest marginal return that cost is the nadir
